channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Delon Wright | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Delon Wright from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Delon Wright
item.description:
But after Kyle Kuzma pushed the shorthanded Washington Wizards ahead with his own difficult 3-pointer with 6.2 seconds left, LaVine found himself having to explain his decision to take a 16-foot jumper with 2.3 seconds left rather than attempting another 3-pointer.

“We were just trying to get a 3 off. And then when I went in to go pullup, I think it was Delon Wright fouled me. My instinct was to go up and try to get a 3-point play,”

Zach LaVine on Delon Wright, Jan 12, 2023. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Troy Weaver on Delon Wright
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Weaver on Delon Wright:

“He was tremendous here in Detroit, he exceeded expectations, he was able to fill in at both guard positions ... happy for him in restoring his career and wish him all the best going forward.”

Troy Weaver on Delon Wright, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Jerami Grant on Derrick Rose, Delon Wright, Killian Hayes, Saben Lee
item.description:
Rod Beard:#Pistons Jerami Grant on Hayes/Rose injuries and relying on Delon Wright and Saben Lee:

“It's definitely tough, but they're ready; they put a lot of work in.”

Jerami Grant on Derrick Rose, Delon Wright, Killian Hayes, Saben Lee, Jan 7, 2021. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Bobby Webster on Delon Wright
item.description:
Raps GM Bobby Webster on not extending 4th yr G Delon Wright:

“We love Delon. It was mutual [not to extend]. ... he had some [bad] luck with his shoulder in his second year so I think this is a great chance for him to make another jump and for us to see it.”

Bobby Webster on Delon Wright, Oct 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @michaelgrange.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Delon Wright
item.description:
“Delon Wright may see some minutes at the three because he’s a versatile young man. Bruno (Caboclo) gives you a standstill shooter. So we’re going to look at a lot of different attributes for that position, and then who fits with the second unit.”

Dwane Casey on Delon Wright, Sep 27, 2017. Source: Toronto Star.
